last_accepted_lead_decision.rationale: The archived reference identifies IMA1/YGR287C as the S288C isomaltase. The original reports distinguish a maltose-induced transcript ratio from initial rate per mass of purified protein. The latter preparation was expressed in CEN.PK113-5D using a CEN.PK113-7D-derived template. The isomaltose control was active, and a separate experiment measured inhibition of isomaltose hydrolysis by maltose. The identified population study associates growth on maltose with MAL gene copy number. Retain the decision against pooling and check the commissioned reports for any additional evidence of reference-sequence identity before closing.
